description: Create (default) or revoke a public read-only inspect link for an app: a shareable URL showing live status and recent deploy history without login. Returns inspectUrl. Calling create again rotates the token (the old link dies). Pass revoke=true to kill the link. The public view is sanitized — no logs, no env, no deploy notes, no owner identity.

revoke.description: Revoke the app's inspect link instead of creating one

name: percher_inspect_link
